title: Multyr Strategy Metadata (static)
description: Versioned, STATIC-only descriptive metadata for a Multyr strategy. This document MUST NOT contain runtime/dynamic values (APY, APR, TVL, AUM, capacity, utilization, current allocations/weights, share price, holder counts, volumes). Those are served by the runtime metrics API and keyed to this document by `id`. This document MUST NOT contain a risk rating, risk score, risk grade, or a safety/quality label ("low risk", "safe", "conservative", ...) until a formal Multyr risk-rating methodology is published and given its own schema version.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS schema that the document targets. The validator selects the schema file whose declared version matches.

id.description: Globally unique, permanently stable strategy identifier. Convention: 'multyr-' + slug. This is the join key for the runtime metrics API.

slug.description: URL-safe short name, unique per network. The metadata file MUST be named '<slug>.json'.

name.description: Human-readable product name. Should match the on-chain strategy `name()` constant where one exists.

symbol.description: Optional. Ticker of the share/receipt token users hold, when distinct from the deposit asset (e.g. the ERC-4626 vault share symbol).

tagline.description: One-line positioning statement. No performance claims, no risk/safety labels.

description.description: Short paragraph describing what the strategy does and how. No performance claims, no risk/safety labels, no dynamic figures.

type.description: Optional finer-grained sub-type within the category, e.g. 'multi-market-lending'.

symbol.description: Primary asset the strategy is denominated in.

accountingAsset.description: Asset NAV / share price is denominated in.

principalGuaranteed.description: Whether principal is contractually guaranteed. For DeFi strategies this is effectively always false.

yieldVariable.description: Whether the yield is variable / not fixed.

protocols.description: Eligible external protocols the strategy MAY allocate to. This is an eligibility set only — it is NOT a current-allocation list and carries no weights.

anchorProtocols.description: Optional. Subset of `protocols` designated as primary/anchor venues by the strategy design. Descriptive only; not enforced by this document.

allocation.description: Description of the allocation POLICY. Must not contain concrete allocations, weights, or amounts.

criteria.description: Named inputs the allocation rules evaluate (e.g. 'yield', 'liquidity', 'capacity', 'protocol-risk').

riskControls.description: Named risk-control MECHANISMS present in the strategy (e.g. 'per-adapter exposure caps', 'adapter quarantine'). Mechanism names only — never a score, rating, or grade.

riskFactors.description: Categories of risk the strategy is exposed to. This is an unordered set of factor labels, NOT a severity assessment.
